Mod.Name: MU80 Soundtrack
Mod.Author: Raymond
Mod.Description: Final Fantasy 7 soundtrack mod featuring the original XG (eXtended General) MIDI data from the 1998 PC release, as rendered through a rackmount Yamaha MU80 sound module (closest hardware equivalent of the original S-YXG70 software synthesizer). -2 options for the track "One-Winged Angel" (lb2) are included--1 with and 1 without vocal choir. -Credit and a debt of gratitude go to Raymond from the old SE forums for the original recordings. Additional authors: Template, Dte102, NidoLNorris
